reply_text:
I told Hollis in a thread on his question in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47, not Dock 23.

Before answering, I confirmed Hollis is a member of #central-team and read that channel's history. On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 there, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same day. Nothing after that changes the site.

The two summaries I wrote after Pree's messages were also posted to #central-team as their own messages. The second one already says Gate 47 replaces Dock 23, so it doesn't contradict anything. My Oct 14 thread reply that says Dock 23 is still there, but Hollis's answer explicitly says to ignore Dock 23.
